settings.title: What products does Anupam Stores offer?
settings.description: We offer a wide range of household appliances, kitchen essentials, and daily-use products designed for both homes and businesses.

settings.title: Where is Anupam Stores located?
settings.description: We are based in Jaipur and serve customers locally as well as across India through our online store.

settings.title: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.description: We accept UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and cash on delivery (COD) on eligible orders.

settings.title: What is your return policy?
settings.description: We offer easy returns on eligible products within a specified time period. Products must be unused and in original packaging.
